questions.question: Who is addressed in the opening line of Acts?
questions.verseText: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,
questions.explanation: Acts opens by addressing Theophilus and linking this book to the earlier account of Jesus' works and teaching.

questions.question: For how many days did Jesus appear to the apostles after his suffering?
questions.verseText: He showed himself alive after he suffered by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God's Kingdom.
questions.explanation: Luke says Jesus presented himself alive by many proofs and was seen over forty days.

questions.question: Where did Jesus command the disciples to wait?
questions.verseText: He commanded them not to depart from Jerusalem, but to wait for the promise of the Father.
questions.explanation: They were told to stay in Jerusalem until they received the promised Holy Spirit.

questions.question: What received Jesus out of their sight as he was taken up?
questions.verseText: As they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.
questions.explanation: The ascension account says a cloud hid Jesus from the apostles' sight.

questions.question: சீடர்கள் எருசலேமில் எதற்காகக் காத்திருக்க வேண்டும்?
questions.verseText: எருசலேமை விட்டுப் போகாமல், பிதாவின் வாக்குத்தத்தத்துக்காகக் காத்திருங்கள் என்று இயேசு கட்டளையிட்டார்.
questions.explanation: அப்போஸ்தலர் 1:4-இல் இயேசு பரிசுத்த ஆவியைப் பற்றிய பிதாவின் வாக்குத்தத்தத்துக்காக எருசலேமில் காத்திருக்கச் சொல்கிறார்.
